title: Yuhuan case · Lending, debt collection and the conflict

views.label: Yu Huan and his mother vs debt collectors

sources.name: Guiding Case No. 93: Yu Huan, intentional injury
sources.quote: An ongoing unlawful deprivation of personal liberty is an "unlawful infringement" under Article 20(1) of the Criminal Law, against which justifiable defence may be exercised.

sources.name: Loan contract (RMB 1 million)
sources.quote: On 28 July 2014 Su and her husband Yu borrowed RMB 1 million from Wu and Zhao, orally agreeing on 10% monthly interest.

sources.name: House sale contract (RMB 250,000 security)
sources.quote: The other RMB 250,000 was arranged through a house sale contract using a flat in Yu's name as security; the parties agreed that on default the flat would be transferred to Zhao.

sources.name: Body-camera footage and on-site surveillance
sources.quote: Su identified Du as having slapped Yu Huan; Du and the others denied it and called it an economic dispute; the officers warned both sides not to use force; Yu Huan tried to leave and was stopped by the debt collectors.

sources.name: Post-mortem examination opinion
sources.quote: Du died of haemorrhagic shock caused by laceration of the proper hepatic artery and trauma to the right lobe of the liver following an abdominal injury.

events.label: Su and her husband borrow RMB 1 million from Wu and Zhao
events.detail: The parties orally agreed on 10% monthly interest; this loan became the origin of the later debt dispute.

events.label: Su repays RMB 1.54 million in total
events.detail: During the repayment period, because Su was late, Wu and Zhao directed others to press for repayment by camping in the Yuanda Company bicycle shed and setting up a cooking stove in front of the office building.

events.label: Su and her husband borrow a further RMB 350,000
events.summary: RMB 250,000 of it secured on a flat
events.detail: RMB 100,000 at 10% monthly interest agreed orally; the other RMB 250,000 through a house sale contract using a flat in Yu's name as security, to be transferred to Zhao on default.

events.label: Su repays a further RMB 298,000
events.detail: Wu and Zhao considered the payment to be interest on the first RMB 1 million, while Su and her husband considered it repayment of the second loan; after that they made no further repayment and did not transfer the flat.

events.label: Zhao and others change the locks and move in
events.detail: Zhao produced the house sale contract, and the officers left after mediating.

events.label: Zhao and others remove belongings; Wu forces Su's head towards a toilet bowl
events.detail: When the officers responded, Wu said it was a house sale dispute and was told to settle it by negotiation or litigation; after they left, Wu berated Su and forced her head down close to the water in a toilet bowl. That afternoon Zhao and others moved the contents of the flat to the gate of Yuanda Company.

events.label: the parties reach an oral agreement
events.detail: Through others' mediation Yu reached an oral agreement with Wu: the flat would be transferred to Zhao the next day, and after a further RMB 300,000 was paid the principal and interest would be settled in full.

events.label: Zhao gathers a group at Yuanda Company to press for repayment
events.detail: Because Yu and Su did not complete the transfer, Zhao gathered Guo and others at Yuanda Company to press for repayment, shouting in front of the office building, watching inside the finance office and outside the canteen, and barbecuing and drinking outside the lobby while urging Su to repay.

events.label: Du and others enter the reception room, insult and expose themselves
events.detail: Du abused Su, Yu Huan and their family in obscene language, flicked a cigarette butt onto the front of Su's clothing, pulled down his trousers to expose himself and turned his body towards Su and the others; he then took off Yu Huan's shoe and made Su smell it, slapped Yu Huan's face, while other debt collectors pulled Yu Huan's hair and pressed his shoulders down to stop him rising.

events.label: officers reach the reception room then leave to find the caller
events.summary: both sides warned not to fight
events.detail: Officer Zhu and an auxiliary officer reached the reception room to establish the facts; Su and Yu Huan identified Du as having beaten Yu Huan, while Du and the others denied it and said they were collecting a debt; after warning both sides not to fight, the officer took the auxiliary officer into the yard to look for the caller.

events.label: Yu Huan stabs four debt collectors
events.detail: Yu Huan and Su tried to leave with the officers and were blocked; Du and the others seized Yu Huan's neck and pushed and dragged him to the south-east corner; Yu Huan warned them with a single-edged knife with a 15.3 cm blade, Du taunted him and closed in, and Yu Huan stabbed Du once in the abdomen and stabbed Cheng, Yan and Guo once each.

events.label: Du dies despite resuscitation
events.detail: Du was taken to Guanxian People's Hospital and died at 02:18 the next day despite resuscitation; Yan and Guo suffered second-degree serious injuries and Cheng a second-degree minor injury.
